# MultiDatePick

> MultiDatePick is a Salesforce-native Lightning Web Component suite that drops calendar, scheduling, and resource-booking interfaces into Flows, Lightning Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages, and Experience Sites with no code. Three components share a configurable base: Date for multi-date selection with ranges and recurring patterns; Date Time for date plus per-date or shared time-slot scheduling with conflict detection; and Booking for resource reservation with capacity tracking, live availability badges, business hours per resource, multi-resource checkboxes, bulk inline edit mode, and booking rules (minimum notice, a rolling book-ahead window and buffer time between bookings), plus an Add to Calendar file (.ics) after every save. The suite renders FIVE interchangeable views from one component (calendar month grid, resource timeline, week-by-hour grid, capacity utilization heatmap, and chronological agenda list), all reading the same records through the same field mappings and saving through the same path, chosen per placement via the view and availableViews properties. The suite ships 65+ configurable properties, six storage shapes (per-date, per-range, per-time-block, parent + sub-blocks, per-resource × date), status-color theming on any picklist, additive-only auto-save, a guided Setup Wizard with JSON import/export and Smart Field Mapping, pre-built configurations, each shipping a default view and switcher list, and built-in translations for 9 languages.

## Core pages

- [MultiDatePick home](https://multidatepick.com/): Salesforce calendar suite for picking many dates, scheduling times and booking rooms, people or equipment. Three components (Date, Date Time, Booking), five views (calendar, timeline, week, utilization, agenda), six record shapes, a Setup Wizard and Screen Flow support. 100% native, passed the Salesforce Security Review. No Apex required. $20/user/month.
- [Set Up MultiDatePick in Salesforce: Getting Started](https://multidatepick.com/gettingstarted.html): Five-step setup with GIFs: install (at launch), assign permission sets, build a config in the Setup Wizard (or import one from the Config Library), add the calendar to a Lightning page or a Screen Flow. The package ships guided flows (Intro to MultiDatePick and Deep Dive flows). No Apex required.
- [Salesforce Multi-Date & Range Picker LWC | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/multidatepickdates.html): The Date component. Users click many dates, drag a date range or add recurring patterns; dates save as child records (one per date or one per range) or return to a Screen Flow. 60+ properties, five views, 15 use cases, setup for Lightning pages and Flows, FAQ and the full properties reference.
- [Date Time: Salesforce Date and Time Slot Picker](https://multidatepick.com/multidatepickdatetime.html): The MultiDatePick Date Time component, a calendar time slot picker for Salesforce Screen Flows, record, App, Home and Experience Cloud pages. Pick many dates, drag times in a grid or use dropdowns at any interval (15, 30 or 60 minutes are typical), shared or per-date times, conflict detection, periods, status colors, how records save, Flow outputs and the full reference of 90+ properties.
- [Salesforce Booking Calendar & Resource Scheduler](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-booking-calendar.html): the Booking component. Book rooms, equipment, vehicles and people (any object, including User) with time slots at any interval, live capacity badges, conflict detection (block, skip, allow), buffer time between bookings, minimum notice and a rolling booking window, Add to Calendar (.ics) after saving, multi-resource booking, business hours, blocked dates, five views, Experience Cloud self-service, 15 use cases, FAQ and the full reference of 100+ settings.
- [User Guide](https://multidatepick.com/user-guide.html): Admin guide to the three components, six record shapes, the five-step Setup Wizard, the four permission sets (one for public-site guests), five views, capacity, closures, guest pages, Flow recipes and every property by label.
- [MultiDatePick on App, Home & Experience Pages](https://multidatepick.com/home-app-experience.html): Put the calendar on App Pages, Home Pages and Experience Sites with Static Parent Record Id, or drive the parent from a Flow; includes a setup GIF, the four-property Save checklist and the five-step public guest site checklist.
- [Pricing | MultiDatePick for Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/pricing.html): $20 per user per month, one plan with every feature included: no tiers, add-ons or feature gates, all future updates included, and a 30-day free trial of the complete product with no card required. Passed the Salesforce Security Review; 100% native.
- [Trust & Security | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/trust.html): Data handling and security: 100% native with no external servers, callouts or subprocessors; passed the Salesforce AppExchange Security Review; all Apex runs in USER_MODE with FLS and sharing enforced; four permission sets (MultiDatePick - Setup, MultiDatePick - User, MultiDatePick - All Access, and MultiDatePick - Guest for public-site guests).
- [FAQ](https://multidatepick.com/faq.html): Pre-sales answers: Security Review passed, 100% native (data stays in your org), supported editions, permission sets, no Apex required, $20/user/month with a 30-day free trial.
- [Troubleshooting](https://multidatepick.com/troubleshooting.html): Every setup message and access error with a screenshot, the cause and a short fix, including field security and guest-site sharing.

## Solutions

- [Salesforce Calendar: What It Does and What It Leaves Out](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar.html): What the built-in Salesforce Calendar does (Day, Week, Month and Table views, object calendars, event series), where it stops, and how MultiDatePick adds multiple dates per record, time slots, capacity booking and five views.
- [Salesforce Calendar for Staffing & Recruiting](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-staffing-recruiting.html): Scheduling for staffing agencies in Salesforce: candidate availability, interview slots, shift capacity, placements and credential dates, a recruiter roster using User as the resource, starter configs and an FAQ.
- [Salesforce Interview Scheduling Calendar](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-interview-scheduling.html): Interview scheduling in Salesforce: dates and time slots of any length, a week grid, interviewers as resources with their own hours, conflict checks on save, panel capacity, candidate self-booking, starter configs and an FAQ.
- [Salesforce Conference Room Booking & Desk Booking](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-conference-room-booking-calendar.html): Meeting room and desk booking in Salesforce: rooms from any object, every room on a timeline, no double booking, hours and closures per room, desk capacity, a utilization heatmap, starter configs and an FAQ.
- [Salesforce Experience Cloud Booking Calendar | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-experience-cloud-booking.html): Self-service booking on a public or member Experience Cloud site: the live demo is a public guest booking site, a five-step setup (Setup Wizard config, Config Name, Static Parent Record Id), what guest users can and cannot do, and which view to show them.
- [Salesforce Lightning Scheduler alternative](https://multidatepick.com/salesforce-calendar-vs-lightning-scheduler.html): Salesforce Lightning Scheduler (now Salesforce Scheduler) compared with MultiDatePick: data model, licensing, Experience Cloud booking, rooms and capacity, a feature table, when to choose which, and an FAQ.

## Blog

- [Salesforce Utilization Heatmap: See Who Is Overbooked](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-utilization-heatmap.html): A Salesforce utilization heatmap: each resource down the side, every day showing booked against capacity, overbooking flagged, one click into the schedule.
- [Salesforce Add to Calendar: Bookings Into Outlook and Google](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-add-to-calendar.html): Give every Salesforce booking an Add to Calendar button: one .ics file for Outlook, Google and Apple Calendar after Save, even for Experience Cloud guests. No code.
- [Salesforce Campaign Dates: Every Event Day, No Apex](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-campaign-multiple-dates.html): Track every date of a Salesforce Campaign on one calendar: tour stops, webinar series and volunteer days saved as child records, with status colors. No Apex.
- [Salesforce Timeline View: Every Resource on One Screen](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-timeline-view.html): A Salesforce resource timeline: rooms, people and equipment down the side, dates across, multi-day bookings as one bar, and drag to reschedule. No code.
- [Section 508 Calendar for Salesforce Government Orgs](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-section-508-government-calendar.html): State and local agencies now have until April 2027 to meet WCAG 2.1 AA. What that means for scheduling in Salesforce, and the accessible calendar built for it.
- [Five Calendar Views, One Salesforce Component](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-calendar-views.html): A month grid cannot answer every scheduling question. Timeline, week, utilization and agenda alongside it, chosen per placement with one config field.
- [Why Salesforce Has No Multi-Date Calendar](https://multidatepick.com/blog/why-salesforce-has-no-multi-date-calendar.html): A Salesforce date field holds one date, and every workaround leaks somewhere. Why there is no multi-date field, and the calendar component that fills the gap.
- [Configure a Salesforce Calendar Without Code](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-calendar-setup-wizard.html): 100+ properties sounds like a project. It is a Setup Wizard, three questions about your records, and a live preview that renders the real Salesforce calendar.
- [Salesforce VPAT: What Admins Need to Know](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-vpat-accessibility.html): What a VPAT is, why it surfaces during Salesforce procurement, how to read its conformance levels, and four questions to ask an AppExchange vendor.
- [Prevent Double Booking in Salesforce: Conflicts & Capacity](https://multidatepick.com/blog/prevent-double-booking-in-salesforce.html): Validation rules fire after the user has already chosen. How to check availability before selection, and handle capacity where more than one booking fits.
- [Calendar Time Slot Picker for Salesforce, No Code](https://multidatepick.com/blog/salesforce-calendar-time-slot-picker.html): A Salesforce time slot picker: a calendar with bookable slots at any interval, taken times hidden before anyone clicks, live capacity counts, and no code.
- [Recurring Date Patterns in Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/blog/recurring-date-patterns-in-salesforce.html): Every Monday and Thursday for six weeks is a pattern a date range cannot hold. Recurring selection patterns in Salesforce, and how to get them without code.
- [Multiple Dates in a Salesforce Screen Flow](https://multidatepick.com/blog/multiple-dates-in-a-salesforce-screen-flow.html): How to capture many dates in one Salesforce Flow screen, and what to do with the collection afterwards. Loops, parsing and the limits of standard components.
- [Salesforce Calendar and Scheduling Blog | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/blog/): Salesforce calendar and scheduling guides: time slot pickers, timeline and utilization views, double-booking, recurring dates, Screen Flows and accessibility.

## Optional

- [Config Library: Ready-to-Import Configs | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/configlibrary.html): 41 ready-to-import configs (Date, Date Time, Booking) with key settings shown by admin label. Copy one into the Setup Wizard's Import tab, then use it by Config Name on a Lightning page, Experience site or Flow screen; a three-question filter finds the right one.
- [Salesforce Screen Flow Guide | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/flowcheatsheet.html): Put MultiDatePick in a Screen Flow by setting one property, Config Name. Parent Record Id saves against a record. Covers the flow outputs, the ready-made Parse Date Entries from JSON action, and a manual property-mapping appendix. No Apex required.
- [Accessibility & VPAT 2.5 | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/accessibility.html): VPAT 2.5 report for managed package 0.12.0-4 against WCAG 2.1 A/AA, Revised Section 508 and EN 301 549, verified October 21, 2026. Zero axe-core violations on the Date, Date Time and Booking components and all five calendar views.
- [Deploy a Flow with VS Code | MultiDatePick](https://multidatepick.com/deploy-flow-vscode.html): Deploy a starter Screen Flow from the Flow loops post into a Salesforce org with VS Code and the Salesforce CLI in about 15 minutes, then finish in Flow Builder.
- [Get Notified at Launch | MultiDatePick for Salesforce](https://multidatepick.com/notify-me-at-launch.html): Sign up for a launch note when MultiDatePick arrives on the Salesforce AppExchange. $20/user/month with every feature, 30-day free trial, passed Security Review; links to the live demo.
